title: IFRA discusses responsible fragrance at Beautyworld Dubai
summary: Alexander Mohr, President of IFRA , joined the Next in Fragrance Conference at Beautyworld Dubai for a panel on regulations, ethics and the planet, alongside Ajmal Group and the Oud Grading Institute.

extraction.key_fact: 국제향료협회 회장이 뷰티월드 두바이의 컨퍼런스에 참여하여 규제와 윤리 및 지구 환경을 주제로 패널 토론을 진행했다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: Alexander Mohr, President of IFRA , joined the Next in Fragrance Conference at Beautyworld Dubai for a panel on regulations, ethics and the planet, alongside Ajmal Group and the Oud Grading Institute.
